analysis.title: GS US Equity Outlook - SPX to 8700
key_insights: GS forecasts the S&P 500 will rise 17% to 8,700 by year-end 2027, in its published US Equity Outlook for 2027.
The 17% forecast gain compares with a 21% annualized return over the past four years, so GS expects returns to stay positive but moderate.
GS expects S&P 500 EPS growth to slow from roughly 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027.
GS names earnings, a solid economy and continued AI investment as the key drivers of the forecast.
The S&P 500 forward P/E fell 19% in 2026 and sits near its 10-year average. GS expects rates and AI uncertainty to keep it near 18x.
GS themes for 2027: AI Productivity Candidates, Buyback Aristocrats, Energy Infra, Transport, Healthcare (biopharma, managed care) and selected Staples (beauty, energy drinks, nicotine).
